papers.title_en: MixFold: Sub-4-Bit Mixed-Precision LLM Inference via Output-Channel Grouping on Mobile NPUs
papers.authors: Vinnam Kim, Seong Hoon Seo, Junhan Kim, Jaeseong You, An Chen
papers.evidence: 移动 NPU 上的亚 4 比特混合精度量化大模型推理内核
papers.tldr: 移动 NPU 上 sub-4-bit 量化虽省内存，却因矩阵单元仅支持少数原生整型、向量单元转换权重而难以加速解码。MixFold 用原生整型直接执行 3-bit 与完美对称 2-bit 权重，并按输出通道分组对齐矩阵单元 tile 分配数据类型，实现细于层级的混合精度。在骁龙 8 Elite Gen 5 Hexagon NPU 上，它相对 llama.cpp 解码快 1.16-1.41 倍，每焦耳生成 token 多 1.5-4.3 倍，精度相当或更高。该工作让 sub-4-bit 混合精度在移动端真正转化为速度与能效收益。
papers.abstract_en: Sub-4-bit quantization allows mobile devices to run larger LLMs, but its memory savings do not always translate into faster decoding on mobile NPUs. Their matrix units support only a few native integer datatypes, and converting unsupported weight formats on the vector unit can erase the gains from fewer bits. Mixed precision faces an additional constraint: each matrix-unit tile uses one datatype. MixFold executes 3-bit and perfectly symmetric 2-bit weights using native integer operations without expanding the weights to wider datatypes during decoding. MixFold then assigns datatypes to output-channel groups aligned with the matrix-unit tiles, enabling finer-than-layer assignment without disrupting matrix-unit execution. We compare MixFold with llama.cpp Hexagon backend on the Qualcomm Hexagon NPU of a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5. Across the Qwen3 model family, MixFold achieves comparable or higher accuracy than llama.cpp's sub-4-bit formats at matched bits per weight, while decoding 1.16-1.41 times faster and generating 1.5-4.3 times more tokens per joule.

papers.title_en: FORTH: Grounding Tactile VLA Execution via Forward-Only Proxy-Control Pairing
papers.authors: Junde Li, Wei-Han Yu, Xiangyi Chu, Yaoxin Li, Jiawei Xu, Ka-Fai Un, Pui-In Mak
papers.evidence: 基于前向代理-控制配对的触觉接地VLA执行框架
papers.tldr: VLA常被认为具备力控能力，但代理损失最小并不保证物理力接地。FORTH提出仅前向测量与执行框架，将各层优化目标与物理控制可观测量配对，含前向触觉编码器、零阶适配器与SlipGuard滑移门。在弹塑性结构壳上，峰值抓握力较单调反射斜坡低29倍并避免压溃；三个LIBERO套件平均成功率97.6%，峰值激活内存降7.12倍。表明增强感知可带来更深物理智能。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are widely credited with force control, operating on the unverified assumption that proxy loss minimization implies physical force grounding. In this work, we demonstrate that this assumption breaks down at three core deployment levels: frozen visual backbones discard contact geometry, downstream losses mask token-level gradient alignment, and discrete indicators trigger optimization collapse. To address these disconnections, we present FORTH, a forward-only measurement harness and execution framework that explicitly pairs the optimization objective at each level with its physical control observable. FORTH incorporates three grounded pillars: a layer-local, forward-only tactile encoder that preserves spatial contact geometry without backpropagation, a token-parallel zeroth-order adapter enabling activation-space updates, and SlipGuard, a continuous tactile verification gate that fires on incipient slip. On an elasto-plastic structural shell, FORTH's closed-loop gate peaks at 29 times lower grip force than a monotone reflex ramp, preventing structural crush where the baseline leaves permanent deformation. Furthermore, FORTH matches state-of-the-art execution performance with a 97.6% average success rate across three evaluated LIBERO suites, while reducing peak activation memory by 7.12 times compared to a backpropagated step on the same backbone. Enhanced perception enables deeper physical intelligence.

papers.title_en: PonderPounce-WM: When Does Predicting the Future Help Context-Dependent Robot Control?
papers.authors: Jaeyoon Jung, Suhwan Choi, Yunsung Lee, Youngjae Yu
papers.evidence: 预训练多模态大模型认知模块耦合动作模型实现上下文相关机器人控制
papers.tldr: 面向依赖上下文的机器人控制，未来预测如何起作用仍不清楚。PonderPounce-WM在PonderPounce上加入三个未来token，用视觉特征变化做辅助监督，并由Ponder把历史与示范整合为连续认知供Pounce使用。RoboMME中认知优先排序且仅传递认知，成功率从60.83%提升到67.42%；真实机器人四任务平均成功率达67.44%。结果表明未来预测可通过辅助监督改善控制，无需把未来token直接交给动作模型。
papers.abstract_en: How does future prediction affect context-dependent robot control? We introduce PonderPounce-WM, extending PonderPounce with three future tokens supervised to predict visual-feature changes. Its pretrained MLLM, Ponder, integrates history and demonstrations into continuous cognition for the action model, Pounce. We investigate token ordering and delivery to distinguish predictive supervision from direct future conditioning. On RoboMME, cognition-first ordering with cognition-only delivery improves success from 60.83% to 67.42%. With the same ordering, direct future-token delivery yields 64.00% success. Probes show increased future information in cognition while the tested past-event attributes remain largely decodable. Across four real-robot tasks, PonderPounce-WM achieves 67.44% mean success under asynchronous execution, compared with 60.98% for PonderPounce. These results suggest that future prediction can improve context-dependent control through auxiliary supervision without delivering future tokens to the action model.

papers.title_en: FoRe: A Force-Guided Framework for Autonomous Grasp Recovery in Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Shuai Peng, Yongkai Liao, Yuxin Cheng, Haoyuan Wang, Jian Huang
papers.evidence: 面向视觉-语言-动作模型的力引导自主抓取恢复框架
papers.tldr: VLA模型在抓取操作中难以可靠恢复局部抓取失败，失败后常继续搬运而非重试。FoRe利用力反馈将演示分为接近-抓取与搬运-放置阶段分别训练策略，并以接近-抓取策略初始化重试策略，通过失败后状态的局部强化学习精炼。推理时控制器结合力反馈与抓取命令状态协调阶段、检测失败并调用重试。在LIBERO-SUCTION、LIBERO及真实任务上，FoRe持续提升VLA-Adapter和π0.5成功率，并构建力增强基准LIBERO-SUCTION。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong performance in grasp-based manipulation, yet reliable recovery from local grasping failures remains challenging. Specifically, in pick-and-place tasks, policies may continue transport after a failed grasp instead of retrying, potentially reflecting overreliance on proprioceptive cues for stage progression and limited retry supervision. Existing recovery approaches typically rely on deployment-time guidance or demonstration augmentation. We introduce Force-guided Recovery (FoRe), a framework for autonomous recovery from local grasping failures. Using force feedback, FoRe partitions demonstrations into approach-grasp and transport-placement stages to train separate policies. To supplement limited retry supervision, FoRe then initializes a dedicated retry policy from the approach-grasp policy and refines it through local reinforcement learning (RL) from post-failure states. To avoid inappropriate stage progression, a controller combines force feedback with grasp-command status at inference to coordinate the stage policies, detect grasp failures, and invoke the retry policy. We also construct LIBERO-SUCTION, a force-augmented suction manipulation benchmark adapted from LIBERO, with complete demonstration trajectories for policy training. FoRe consistently improves task success rates for VLA-Adapter and $π_{0.5}$ on LIBERO-SUCTION, LIBERO, and real-world tasks. On LIBERO-SUCTION, average absolute gains are 18.4% and 6.5%, respectively. The corresponding real-world absolute gains are 25.0% and 21.7%. FoRe also remains effective with only one demonstration per task on both simulation benchmarks.

papers.title_en: BeyondEgo: Learning to Act Beyond Egocentric Perception via Humanoid Ego-Exo Foresight
papers.authors: Zhaoshan Yang, Chenglei Li, Haoyu Lei, Yutao Zhang, Yuyu Yang, Zhuo Chen, Ling Ding, Zhongxing Ren, Yi Gu, Heyang Zhang, Peng Su, Jin Pan
papers.evidence: 以第一人称VLA策略结合外视角与未来预测实现人形操作
papers.tldr: 人形移动操作中，仅用自我中心视觉的VLA策略易忽略身体与场景关系，动作模仿也缺少未来场景监督。BeyondEgo在空间上拼接同步外中心视角的冻结DINOv3 token与自我中心VLM token，在时间上以双视角未来观测训练残差适配器，并用0.6秒后的DINOv3表示作特权监督。部署仅保留4.2M适配器。在闭环基准HELM上，成功率由48.0%升至92.0%，200个迁移场景由23.5%升至65.0%，消融表明双视角DINOv3前瞻迁移最佳。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid loco-manipulation requires coordinating whole-body motion to perform manipulation tasks in complex environments. Yet egocentric vision-language-action (VLA) policies can miss critical body--scene relationships, and action imitation alone provides no explicit supervision for future scene evolution. We propose BeyondEgo to extend VLA perception in space and time. Spatially, we encode a synchronized exocentric view with frozen DINOv3 and concatenate the resulting tokens with egocentric VLM tokens to condition the action expert. Temporally, we use future observations from both views as privileged supervision for a residual adapter on task-conditioned VLM features. A foresight expert regresses DINOv3 representations of both views 0.6s ahead. At deployment, the foresight expert is discarded and the 4.2M-parameter adapter is retained. We also introduce HELM, to our knowledge, the first closed-loop humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark with synchronized egocentric and exocentric views across five whole-body tasks.On HELM, BeyondEgo improves success from 48.0% to 92.0% in distribution and from 23.5% to 65.0% on 200 held-out scenes with layout, asset, material, and lighting shifts. Ablations show that dual-view DINOv3 foresight yields the best transfer results.

papers.title_en: PLoQ: A Prompt-Specific Low-Rank Basis for 4-bit Quantization of LLM Activations
papers.authors: Faraz Tahmasebi, Michael Pellauer, Hyoukjun Kwon, Sitao Huang
papers.evidence: 面向大模型激活4比特量化的提示特定低秩基
papers.tldr: 低比特激活量化受少数主导方向制约，现有离线校准将高精度子空间固定并折入权重，难保护每个提示的独有方向。PLoQ采用提示自适应低秩分解，量化前提取主导激活成分并单独量化，在层内GEMM恢复且不改权重，基由预填充阶段估计并在解码复用。相同位宽下，它在1B至70B的六个Llama/Qwen模型上全面优于先进混合精度量化，最高恢复46%困惑度损失。8k上下文仅增4%预填充和8%解码开销。
papers.abstract_en: Low-bit activation quantization of large language models remains challenging, as a small number of dominant directions dictate the quantization range. State-of-the-art methods isolate these directions in a high-precision subspace through transformations calibrated offline and folded into the weights, which fixes the subspace for all prompts, leaving each prompt's few unique directions unprotected, and rules it out wherever no weight can absorb the transformation. We present PLoQ, a prompt-adaptive low-rank decomposition that extracts the dominant activation components before quantization, quantizes them separately, and restores them within the layer's GEMM, without modifying the weights. The low-rank component's basis is estimated from each prompt during prefill and reused throughout decoding. At the same bit width as state-of-the-art mixed-precision quantization (4-bit weights, activations and K/V cache with an eighth of the channels at 8 bits, about 4.2 bits per activation on average), PLoQ outperforms it on all six Llama and Qwen models from 1B to 70B parameters, at up to 8k tokens (16k on two of them), recovering up to 46% of the perplexity that the state of the art still loses to 4-bit activations. On Llama-3.1-8B at 8k tokens it adds only 4% to prefill and 8% to decoding.

papers.title_en: Learning from Incomplete Actions: Interval Motion Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.authors: Yunpeng Mei, Chenyu Wang, Xiaowen Zhu, Chenbo Xin, Hongjie Cao, Yiyuan Li, Chengye Zhang, YuAn Wang, Gang Wang
papers.evidence: 利用多模态示教训练视觉-语言-动作策略，处理动作缺失
papers.tldr: 自中心演示视觉标注常在动作监督中留下连续缺口，但缺口两端可靠位姿仍提供净平移与旋转。方法在可靠局部动作上保留流匹配，并用组合目标约束缺失动作估计的总运动；缺口超时域时拼接固定窗口，共享区间分支从端点学习并提供目标。LIBERO在20%演示、70.5%动作缺失下达87.9%成功率，较掩码高10.5%；RoboTwin 45.4%对40.3%，五个真机任务59.6%对54.8%和48.8%。该区间运动监督为不完整动作下的VLA训练提供方案。
papers.abstract_en: Visual labeling of egocentric demonstrations often leaves contiguous gaps in action supervision. Reliable poses around a gap still provide its net translation and rotation. We use this information to train vision-language-action policies while preserving ordinary flow matching on reliable local actions. A composition objective constrains the aggregate motion of missing-action estimates, combining multiple fixed windows when a gap exceeds the policy horizon. A shared interval branch learns from reliable endpoints and supplies the composition target. On LIBERO with 20% of demonstrations and 70.5% missing actions, the main method achieves 87.9% mean success over three training runs. In one paired comparison with matched observation exposure and training cost, its advantage over masking is 10.5%. On Ego-informed RoboTwin gaps, success is 45.4%, versus 40.3% for masking. On five real-robot tasks, mean success is 59.6%, versus 54.8% for interval flow matching alone and 48.8% for masking.

papers.title_en: Exploring the Potential of Ultra-Low-Bit Inference on LLM Accelerators
papers.authors: Hao Wang, Yang Shi, Jiageng Shi, Qiuran Li, Yaohua Wang
papers.evidence: 面向大模型加速器的超低位向量量化推理
papers.tldr: 向量量化（VQ）能把大语言模型压缩到极低位宽，但反量化时的码本查找与常规加速器数据流冲突，使压缩难以转化为性能收益。已有方案依赖专用加速器，硬件开销大或场景受限。本文提出 VQACC，复用脉动阵列加速器已有的操作数缓存与端口资源完成码本查找，把反量化无缝融入正常操作数寻址流程。在 EVA 基线上取得 2.63 倍加速，额外硬件仅占计算阵列面积 0.17%。
papers.abstract_en: Vector quantization (VQ) enables ultra-low-bit compression of large language models (LLMs) by encoding groups of values as compact codebook indexes. However, reconstructing these values for computation requires frequent codebook lookups, which conflict with the dataflows of conventional LLM accelerators and limit the performance gains from VQ compression. Consequently, prior work has resorted to VQ-specific accelerator designs, which either incur substantial additional hardware overhead or support only a limited range of inference scenarios. In this work, we argue that existing systolic-array-based LLM accelerators already possess the essential hardware resources for efficient VQ inference, but lack the mechanisms to effectively exploit them. To bridge this gap, we present VQACC, an architectural enhancement that jointly redesigns the existing operand buffer's access logic and data mapping to reuse its storage and port resources for codebook lookups, seamlessly integrating dequantization into the normal operand-addressing dataflow. Evaluation shows that VQACC achieves a 2.63$\times$ speedup over the EVA baseline, with additional hardware occupying only 0.17\% of the compute array's area.

papers.title_en: Efficient VLA Reinforcement Learning via Subchunk Rollouts in Latent World Models
papers.authors: Nan Tang, Han-Tao Zhang, Jing-Cheng Pang, Hao-Nan Wang, Hao-Xiang Ren, Yi-Fei Sheng, Jun-Yin Ye, Tian Xu, Fan-Ming Luo, Hao-Xin Lin, Yang Yu
papers.evidence: 基于模型的强化学习改进预训练视觉-语言-动作策略
papers.tldr: 现有VLA强化学习依赖大规模图像或视频世界模型，计算开销高；潜在世界模型虽高效，却受递归预测误差累积和视觉接口不兼容困扰。LS-MBPO以轻量残差MBRL框架结合分层强制与潜在子块回放，用冻结VLA动作块和潜在残差策略逐段精化。再以进度条件分支起点课程从后段向前段迁移想象回放起点。实验在LIBERO、RoboTwin与真实ALOHA机器人上显示任务性能和训练效率均优于现有方法。
papers.abstract_en: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead. Latent world models offer a more efficient alternative but face two challenges: compounding errors during recursive prediction and incompatibility with VLAs' visual input interfaces. In this work, we propose LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models to improve upon pretrained VLAs. LS-MBPO introduces two key techniques: (1) Hierarchical Forcing, which combines dense causal supervision with autoregressive feedback to mitigate compounding prediction errors; and (2) Latent Subchunk Rollouts, which leverage action chunks from a frozen VLA policy and a latent residual policy for successive subchunk refinement, bridging the gap between latent imagination and VLA policy execution. We further introduce a Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum that progressively shifts rollout starting points from later to earlier task stages, enabling effective policy learning from short imagined rollouts. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world ALOHA robot show that LS-MBPO achieves superior task performance and training efficiency compared to existing methods.

papers.title_en: MomentMem: Memorizing Key Moments for Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Guangyu Zhao, Yongchang Zhang, Ruizhang Jiang, Zhihong Yu, Yuhao Zhang, Tao Wu, Qimin Zhou, Kunsong Shi, Haoran Wen, Zeyu Zhang, Yin Li, Kun Zhan, Yiwu Zhong
papers.evidence: 基于视觉语言模型的关键帧记忆与动作执行器用于机器人操作
papers.tldr: 机器人长时操作常需记住已不可见的关键视觉信息，但完整观测历史冗余，文本摘要又丢失精确细节。作者提出VMBench基准与分层架构MomentMem：由VLM记忆器挑选关键帧，执行器基于所选记忆预测动作。在VMBench上平均成功率达49.9%，比最强基线高31.7个百分点，记忆器还能零样本迁移到新外观。该工作表明保留稀疏视觉证据对依赖记忆的操作更有效。
papers.abstract_en: Robotic manipulation often requires remembering visual information that is no longer observable, such as the original location of an object. Existing approaches typically rely on full observation histories, which become redundant over long horizons, or text summaries, which may omit precise visual details. We study visual moment memory, the ability to retain such details from key moments for subsequent manipulation. To support this study, we introduce VMBench, a suite of long-horizon manipulation tasks requiring memory of spatial locations, visual appearances, and their associations. We further propose MomentMem, a hierarchical architecture in which a VLM-based memorizer selects keyframes and an executor predicts actions conditioned on the selected memories. This separation enables us to evaluate memory selection alongside closed-loop task success and to study memorizer generalization independently of the executor. On VMBench, MomentMem achieves 49.9% average success, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline by 31.7 percentage points. Moreover, we find that the memorizer transfers well to unseen appearances zero-shot. It can also adapt to an unseen task with only a few memory annotations, reaching 43.7% success, close to the 44.3% obtained with full memory supervision. Further experiments show competitive performance on RMBench and improvements in real-robot manipulation. These results highlight the value of retaining sparse visual evidence for memory-dependent manipulation. Our code is available at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MomentMem.

papers.title_en: Analysis of Multi-Client Inference Techniques for Vision-Language-Action Models
papers.authors: Stefan de Lasa, Mohammadreza Mofayezi, Gennady Pekhimenko, Nandita Vijaykumar
papers.evidence: 面向视觉-语言-动作机器人控制模型的多客户端推理服务分析
papers.tldr: VLA 模型可用于泛化机器人控制，但单次推理间隔与推理过程会造成硬件空闲和利用率不足；多客户端并发服务有望提升利用率，但批处理与协同执行尚未在 VLA 上得到系统表征。本文系统刻画这两类多客户端推理技术在延迟、吞吐、功耗和硬件利用率上的权衡。分析揭示了多 VLA 服务的关键取舍与挑战。为后续多客户端 VLA 推理系统设计提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are a new class of machine learning model for generalizable robot control. While they enable robots to perform complex tasks in unseen environments, serving VLAs leaves hardware idle between inference passes and under-utilized during inference. Serving multiple clients at once can improve utilization, but fundamental multi-client techniques such as batching and co-execution have not been characterized for VLAs. We therefore characterize the trade-offs these known techniques impose across latency, throughput, power, and hardware utilization. Our findings inform trade-offs and challenges for future multi-VLA serving systems.

papers.title_en: A Continuous Relaxation of Quantization-Aware Training
papers.authors: Kartikeya Bhardwaj, Mohammed Almousa, Chaitanya Mullapudi, Ananth Balasubramanian, Nithin Ramesan, Tuc Nguyen, Harris Teague
papers.evidence: 渐进位宽变化的低比特量化感知训练
papers.tldr: 低比特量化（2-bit及以下）在通道级方案下部署困难，损失面平坦区与鞍点问题突出。本文提出RelaxQAT，在训练中连续、渐进地调整比特宽度，而非突变或固定精度，对量化感知训练做连续松弛。在视觉任务上平均精度最高提升6.3%，自然语言任务上提升7.7%，优于主流QAT方法。该工作为低比特量化训练提供了简单有效的连续松弛视角与实证依据。
papers.abstract_en: Quantization is a critical piece of the deployment pipeline in the era of large generative models. Low-bit quantization, particularly 2-bits or sub-2-bits, is a notoriously difficult problem, particularly when using a channelwise quantization scheme which has been shown as a leading candidate for hardware-efficiency. The key challenges with low-bit quantization range from limited quantization levels to saddle points or flat regions in the loss surface. In this paper, we look at the problem of flat quantization loss surfaces through a lens of dynamically changing bitwidth. Unlike existing techniques which either change the bit-precision abruptly or keep it fixed, we propose to gradually alter the bitwidth as the model trains. To this end, we propose RelaxQAT, a continuous relaxation of the QAT process. We also provide simple theoretical and empirical insights behind why RelaxQAT helps the QAT performance. Our extensive experiments demonstrate up to 6.3% average accuracy gains on vision and up to 7.7% better average accuracy on natural language tasks, compared to the leading QAT methods.

papers.title_en: SCAP: Stochastic Context for Action Expert Pretraining
papers.authors: Xiao Lin, Yaoxu Lyu, Ronghao Dang, Zhili Liu, Kaijing Ma, Yang Zhou, Dingning Liu, Runzhe Teng, Jun Cen, Shanghang Zhang, Chengju Liu, Qijun Chen
papers.evidence: 视觉-语言-动作模型的动作专家预训练
papers.tldr: 单模态动作专家预训练可抑制视觉捷径，却可能破坏后续视觉-语言联合建模通路。为此提出SCAP：在进入完整输入训练前，随机掩码视觉与文本token。在诊断模型中，SCAP能保住该联合通路并降低对视觉捷径的依赖。四类VLA架构均稳定提升，真机三任务平均成功率76.67%，超全输入预训练25个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Single-modality action-expert pretraining controls competition from visual shortcuts before vision--language--action (VLA) adaptation. Yet single-modality pretraining can impair the vision--language interactions needed for subsequent joint prediction. We construct a diagnostic model in which VA or LA pretraining can disable an initially active pathway for joint vision--language modeling. In this model, subsequent training with complete visual and language inputs cannot restore the pathway, even with unlimited adaptation. We therefore introduce Stochastic Context for Action Expert Pretraining (SCAP), a new action-expert pretraining stage that precedes full-input training. During this stage, visual and text tokens are randomly masked before entering the VLM. In this unified diagnostic model, SCAP can preserve the joint vision--language modeling pathway during pretraining and subsequent full-input training. Compared with direct full-input training, it can also reduce reliance on visual shortcuts and increase reliance on language instructions. SCAP consistently improves performance across four different VLA architectures. In real-robot experiments, it achieves 76.67% average success across three instruction-conditioned manipulation tasks, outperforming full-input pretraining by 25 percentage points.

papers.title_en: NitroGen: Observations on the Action Dynamics, Visual Instruction Following, and Spatial Exploration
papers.authors: Shengyuan Lin, Zhiling Li, Haoyu Nie, Ozan K. Tonguz
papers.evidence: 面向游戏控制的视觉-动作基础模型，支持视觉指令跟随
papers.tldr: NitroGen 是一个面向游戏控制的开放视觉-动作基础模型，通过行为克隆在线游戏视频训练而成。本文以 Hollow Knight 和 Trackmania 为例，冻结控制器并从动作适应、视觉指令跟随、空间探索三个维度进行评估。结果显示模型能根据局部情境调整动作，但缺乏长时程控制所需的规划、失败恢复与探索能力。该工作为游戏视觉-动作基础模型的真实能力边界提供了实证分析。
papers.abstract_en: NitroGen is an open vision-action foundation model for game control. It is trained by behavior cloning on online gameplay videos. In this paper, we study the frozen controller in Hollow Knight and Trackmania as examples along three dimensions: action adaptation, visual instruction following, and spatial exploration. Our results indicate that NitroGen can adapt its actions to local context, but it lacks the planning, recovery, and exploration needed for longer-horizon game control.

papers.title_en: LoCo-WAM: Test-Time Training as Long Context for World-Action Models
papers.authors: Sheng Cheng, Deqian Kong
papers.evidence: 通过测试时训练利用新观测帧指导机器人动作的世界-动作模型
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型通常只依赖很短的观测历史来指导机器人动作，而直接延长历史会带来每步计算量上升，甚至需要单独训练模型。LoCo-WAM 改用在测试时训练的方式，利用新观测帧更新视频专家中的低秩适配器，让适配后的预测指导后续动作，更新在单个 episode 内累积、跨 episode 重置。这样，即使早期观测已经离开输入窗口，仍能影响决策，相当于用更长的经验流替代更长输入。在四个仿真基准上任务成功率均有提升，RoboCasa GR-1 上 2.4 秒历史的模型可匹配 9.6 秒训练模型，4.8 秒版本还高出 4.8 个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: World-action models guide robot actions by predicting what happens next, but typically condition on a short observation history. Extending this history increases computation at every decision and can require a separately trained model. We introduce LoCo-WAM, which learns from the outcomes of its actions through test-time training while keeping the same short history length. It uses newly observed frames to update a low-rank adapter in the video expert, whose adapted predictions guide subsequent actions. The updates accumulate within each episode and are reset between episodes, allowing past observations to influence decisions after they leave the input window. LoCo-WAM thus learns from a longer stream of experience without expert action labels, additional data or meta-training. Experiments on two world-action models show improved task success across four simulation benchmarks. On RoboCasa GR-1, a model with 2.4,s of history matches one trained with 9.6,s, while a model with 4.8,s exceeds it by 4.8 percentage points. Our analysis shows that the updates improve prediction of upcoming frames, affect the action mainly through adaptation of the imagined future, and have an increasing effect on actions as the episode unfolds.

papers.title_en: Beyond Linear Decodability: Understanding and Improving Instruction Following in World Action Models
papers.authors: Bokai Ji, Jiapeng Chen, Yi Zhang, Zeyuan Ding, Yong Dai, Xiaozhu Ju, Jian Tang, Lemao Liu, Dejing Dou, Yong Li
papers.evidence: 世界动作模型依据语言指令预测操作动作
papers.tldr: 世界动作模型操作能力强，却常无法遵循测试时语言指令；非遵循模型虽编码目标信息，但该信息并未控制行为。作者发现遵循模型的目标信息线性可解码性显著更高，提出线性可解码性监督 LDS 作为辅助训练目标。在 LIBERO-CF 上，InternW0-Δ 配合 LDS 达 74.6% 成功率与 89.2% 接地率，分别超最强基线 26.8 和 42.9 个百分点。作者进一步提出先验-指令竞争机制解释非遵循与遵循行为，并将 LDS 重释为指令信号增强，在多种操作任务和视觉域上验证一致有效。
papers.abstract_en: World action models (WAMs) exhibit strong manipulation capabilities yet often fail to follow test-time language instructions. Prior work shows that non-following (NF) WAMs encode information about the instructed target, but this information does not control their behavior. By comparing NF WAM with its instruction-following (IF) counterpart, we find that target information is substantially more linearly decodable in IF WAMs, despite being encoded in both. Motivated by this observation, we introduce linear decodability supervision (LDS), a simple yet effective auxiliary training objective that promotes the linear decodability of the instructed target information. On LIBERO-CF, InternW0-$Δ$ with LDS achieves a success rate of 74.6% and a grounding rate of 89.2%, surpassing the strongest baseline by 26.8 and 42.9 percentage points, respectively. The effectiveness of LDS challenges the prevailing interpretation that encoded target information does not contribute to WAMs' behavior. To reconcile this apparent contradiction, we propose a prior-instruction competition mechanism, which explains NF and IF behavior as arising from the dominance of prior and instruction signals, respectively. We provide causal evidence for this mechanism by evaluating two training-free interventions derived from it. We reinterpret LDS through this mechanism, showing that it acts as a form of instruction signal enhancement. Finally, more comprehensive evaluations across diverse manipulation tasks and visual domains demonstrate the consistent effectiveness of LDS.

papers.title_en: Jagged Robustness: Uneven Safety Transfer and Emerging Vulnerabilities under LLM Quantization
papers.authors: Ramneek Agnihotri, Yingte Xu, Hans Vath
papers.evidence: 审视低精度量化后大语言模型在能力与安全上的退化
papers.tldr: 量化可提升大模型推理效率，但其能力与安全能否同步迁移仍不清楚。作者在Qwen3-4B上系统评测量化对模型防护、指令遵循、伦理与偏见等的影响，并提出Jagged Robustness概念。结果显示防护与偏见更易退化，真实性较稳定，量化模型更易被对全模型良性的通用对抗后缀越狱。该工作警示不能假设全模型性能与鲁棒性会均匀迁移到量化模型。
papers.abstract_en: Quantization enables efficient inference in language models through model parameter compression. This work audits the impact of quantization on capability and safety domains including model safeguards, instruction-following, ethics and bias. Through benchmarks, we find that model safeguards and bias can degrade under quantization, while other capabilities such as truthfulness remain more stable in Qwen3-4B. We define this uneven transfer of LLM capabilities under quantization as Jagged Robustness. We find multiple factors driving Jagged Robustness: task complexity, evaluation method and generation coherence. Moreover, we verify the degradation of model safeguards by observing increased compliance with unsafe requests under quantization, and demonstrate universal adversarial suffix attacks that are benign for the full model but jailbreak quantized models. The findings indicate that it is risky to assume that the performance and robustness can transfer evenly across different capability domains from full models to quantized models.

papers.title_en: FlowScope: 3D Scene Flow Pretraining Improves Surgical Robot Policies
papers.authors: John J. Han, Adam Schmidt, Jingpei Lu, Zooey He, Muhammad Abdullah Jamal, Jie Ying Wu, Omid Mohareri
papers.evidence: 利用无标注视频进行外科手术机器人策略的模仿学习
papers.tldr: 手术机器人模仿学习受限于示教数据成本，而临床立体视频无动作标签难以直接利用。FlowScope利用现成深度与光流模型计算场景流标签，在1149例、135万片段的无标签视频上预训练ACT主干，随后丢弃流预测头。真实系统上，拾针成功率由54%升至90%，首次交接由4%升至52%，完整任务由2%升至14%，且不增加部署推理成本。该工作表明度量三维运动预测是有效的机器人策略预训练信号。
papers.abstract_en: Imitation learning for surgical robots is limited by the cost of collecting demonstrations. Meanwhile, many robot-assisted procedures are recorded as stereo video, yet policies cannot learn from them directly; clinical video carries no action labels. We present FlowScope, which pretrains a surgical policy network on unlabeled clinical video by forecasting scene flow, the metric 3D motion of scene points, with labels computed by off-the-shelf stereo depth and optical flow models. We pretrain the trunk of an Action Chunking Transformer (ACT) on a dataset of 1,149 clinical procedures (1.35M clips) and discard the flow head afterward, so the deployed policy is a standard ACT with no added inference cost. On a real surgical robotic system, FlowScope raises needle pickup success from 54% to 90% and first-handover success on needle regrasp from 4% to 52% (full task: 2% to 14%) over training from scratch (n=50 trials each), and retains its gains with a generative flow-matching action head. Ablations indicate that metric 3D motion is the strongest pretraining signal among those tested; kinematics, 2D tracks, depth alone, and scale-free 3D flow, each paired with kinematics, yield smaller or no gains. Representation analyses suggest that scene-flow pretraining encodes metric needle depth more accurately, that kinematics pretraining increases reliance on the robot state, and that needle-depth probes follow the ordering of real-robot success where offline validation error does not.

papers.title_en: The Vulnerability Window: Decision Instability in Quantized Reward Models
papers.authors: Omkar Shewale, Deepak Kumar, Divakar Kumar Yadav
papers.evidence: 奖励模型4比特量化与决策准确性稳定性
papers.tldr: 奖励模型和LLM评判器常被4比特量化以降低打分成本，但基准准确率几乎不变会掩盖决策不稳。作者跨8个奖励模型、3个生成式评判器和4种量化器，比较量化前后成对偏好与下游best-of-k选择。结果量化改写1.1%—12.3%的偏好判断，准确率却可仅动0.03分，翻转集中在全精度间隔接近量化噪声的“脆弱窗口”。该窗口占比随模型增大从25%降至7%，且基准扰动比下游最终答案变化更敏感，提示应审计决策稳定性而非只看准确率。
papers.abstract_en: Reward models and LLM judges are routinely quantized to 4 bits so that scoring many candidates stays affordable, and the usual check is that benchmark accuracy barely moves. That check is close to blind. Across eight reward models from two families (0.6B-8B), three generative judges and four 4-bit quantizers, quantization rewrites 1.1-12.3% of pairwise preference decisions on RewardBench while aggregate accuracy moves by as little as 0.03 points (p = 1.00), because the errors it fixes and introduces cancel. Flips concentrate where the full-precision margin is small relative to the quantization noise scale sigma: a Gaussian approximation Phi(-|m|/sigma) describes the aggregate rate, over-predicting it in all 30 scalar settings and failing for generative judges, and occupancy of the resulting vulnerability window falls from 25% to 7% with model size, which is what makes small judges fragile. The churn stays within noise under benign best-of-16 and becomes clear under adversarial pressure for some quantizers (146:54 harmful:helpful flips on one family, reversing sign on another). Downstream it changes what ships: across six (model, quantizer) pairs from two families, 14.6-65.7% of problems get a different best-of-64 selection while only 2.6-9.6% get a different final answer, with selections changing 5-8x more often than answers in every pair, and the pair the benchmark calls identical (0.03 points, p = 1.00) still changes 34.5% of them. Benchmark churn ranks that downstream change (rho = 0.89); benchmark accuracy does not order it reliably. Held-out audits then locate the useful diagnostic in the margin rather than the Gaussian: every margin-based predictor orders flips identically (AUC 0.927), and on the level a directly measured churn rate wins in-distribution. As a routing signal it is matched by plain top-k. The contribution is the characterization, not the model.

papers.title_en: PACE-WM: Parallel World Modeling with Action History for Visual Planning
papers.authors: Haishan Liu, Shijie Lian, Bin Yu, Yao Zhang, Changti Wu, Fanping Liu, Jianzheng Liu, Lei Xie, Cong Huang, Kai Chen
papers.evidence: 利用动作历史的并行世界模型用于视觉规划与动作选择
papers.tldr: 视觉规划中相似观测可能对应不同运动状态，仅凭当前帧难以判断未来动作效果。PACE-WM用已执行动作的循环记忆为因果Transformer提供时序上下文，并行预测多个未来表征，避免窗口内递归反馈。规划时提出RAMP，按直接与分裂路径相对共享参考的目标改进评分候选动作。四个任务平均成功率98%，比自回归LeWM快约7-9倍，并构建四类受控基准验证运动消歧与目标适应。
papers.abstract_en: JEPA-style world models support visual planning by predicting future representations conditioned on future actions. However, similar observations can conceal different motion states, making temporal context essential for interpreting future action effects. We propose PACE-WM, a parallel world model that uses executed-action history to contextualize future prediction and planning. Specifically, PACE-WM maintains a recurrent memory of executed actions and uses this memory to condition a causal Transformer. PACE-WM predicts multiple future representations in parallel without recursive predicted-state feedback within each prediction window. We further introduce Reference-Anchored Minimum Progress (RAMP) for action selection during planning. RAMP scores candidate actions by their predicted goal improvement along direct and split paths relative to a shared reference. Across four visual planning tasks, PACE-WM with RAMP achieves an average success rate of $98\%$ and plans approximately $7$-$9\times$ faster than autoregressive LeWM under matched CEM settings. We also construct four controlled benchmarks to evaluate PACE-WM's capabilities in motion disambiguation, goal-relative motion, and goal adaptation. Project page is available at https://github.com/LHS180/PACE-WM.

papers.title_en: Inject, Encode, Navigate: Feature-Wise Time Injection for Rectified Flow with Bidirectional Feature Encoding
papers.authors: Xiaogang Wang, Debasish Mishra, Jia Hao Toh, Wangsheng Liu, Yash Shah
papers.evidence: 面向机器人导航控制的整流流策略与双向Mamba视觉编码
papers.tldr: 面向视觉机器人导航，扩散策略因迭代去噪而推理昂贵。该工作采用单步整流流，并用双向 Mamba 视觉编码器建模跨帧时序依赖，同时提出按流时间步对视觉特征进行注入的条件化设计，以修复时序上下文与整流流耦合不足的问题。多数据集实验表明，该方法在精度与效率上稳定优于基线及竞争方法，为低步数导航策略提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-model-based robotic navigation has gained increasing popularity, yet existing approaches still struggle to deliver effective and efficient navigation performance, \textit{e.g.}, diffusion-based policies that require costly iterative denoising. In this work, we propose three improvements to bridge these gaps. First, we adopt a rectified flow framework to reduce the required inference steps to one while achieving comparable or even superior performance. Second, we leverage a bidirectional Mamba-based visual encoder that employs selective state-space modeling to more effectively capture bidirectional temporal dependencies across observation frames, even with longer input sequences. Most importantly, we find that naïvely combining these two components to balance accuracy with inference speed yields no further performance gains or even produces inferior results. Upon extensive analysis, we realized that the root cause lies in the fact that the Hydra-derived temporal context is shared unchanged across all flow timesteps, and timestep information is introduced only within the velocity network. This weak coupling limits the model's ability to adaptively exploit temporal visual features at different flow states. To address this, we propose a feature-wise timestep conditioning design that explicitly conditions the visual embedding on the flow timestep, enabling noise-level-aware trajectory generation, thereby restoring a meaningful gradient pathway and enabling coherent interaction between the rectified flow and the temporal encoder. Extensive quantitative and qualitative experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that our approach consistently outperforms both baseline and competitive methods.
